summary: The agent read the requirements and saved a first draft of 7 requirements (REQ-001 to REQ-007) covering listing, bidding, live updates, auction closing, currency display, and a split into separate API and live-update services, with no assumptions or out-of-scope items recorded yet. No tool calls failed. Before approving P1, decide the open questions it raised: account roles and whether sellers can bid, bid rules (minimum increment, late-bid extension), the base currency and whether conversion is display-only, the fallback when the exchange rate API is down, and the scale, latency, no-bid, payment and notification scope.
